title: Warm cloud task lease must be keyed on every setting the task is created with
answers: Plan mode not applied to prewarmed cloud task
Warm task starts in Default mode instead of selected permission mode
Why does the warm task lease key include permission mode?
body:
A prewarmed cloud task is created before the user submits, so any launch setting that differs at submit time must be part of the warm lease identity. Otherwise a stale lease is reused with the wrong setting.
- Lease key: `buildWarmTaskLeaseKey` in products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/task-detail/hooks/warmTaskLease.ts (includes runtimeAdapter, model, permissionMode, sandbox env, custom image; reasoningEffort is deliberately NOT in the key).
- `useWarmTask` in products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/task-detail/hooks/useWarmTask.ts: the normalized value must be in the effect deps (re-warm on change), the warm request body (`initial_permission_mode`), and the lease key parts passed on store and take.
- Consumer: `takeWarmTaskLease` call in taskCreationSaga.ts must pass the same values as TaskInput passes to `useWarmTask`, or the lease will not match.
- Skipping any of these makes a task start in Default mode despite Plan being selected.
applies: Desktop cloud task prewarm (useWarmTask, warmTaskLease, taskCreationSaga warm path)
